integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] One continuous eight-second cinematic shot on an outdoor basketball court. One adult athlete wears a fully zipped blue tracksuit and trainers. One orange basketball, the whole player and a clear area of court remain visible. Keep the same player, ball, clothing and court throughout; no cuts, extra players, text or logos.

0.0-1.5 seconds, FAST ACTION: the athlete makes one quick, normal-speed upward toss. The ball clearly separates from the fingertips. This release is the one decisive event.
1.5-5.5 seconds, bullet-time: at the exact instant the released ball clears the fingertips, the action enters bullet-time. The athlete's raised arm, body and separated ball remain almost motionless in world space. Independently, the camera smoothly orbits 90 degrees clockwise from the player's front-left to front-right, at fixed height and distance. One suspended instant and coherent body geometry throughout this camera arc.
5.5-8.0 seconds, RETURN TO NORMAL SPEED: time snaps back to full speed. The same ball rapidly continues its upward and downward trajectory under gravity, visibly hits the court and bounces. The athlete immediately lowers his arm and steps after it. Normal-speed movement continues visibly through the final second. Stable natural daylight.

overall_soundscape: Normal shoe squeak and ball release, a subdued stretched whoosh during bullet-time, then normal-speed court ambience and the ball's impact return at the ending. No speech.

# 07_子弹时间

Bullet Time；FL2VA；LoRA1、20步、res_multistep/simple、192帧/8秒；精确触发词bullet-time。本模板不叠加Turbo/Flex。提示明确正常动作→1.5秒冻结/慢环绕→5.5秒恢复实时；改时长须同步提示阶段。变形时先降专项强度。

本预设192帧@24fps，约8.00秒。

此画布为通用能力预设，示例内容均可替换。只使用所选专项LoRA；不默认全叠加，也不把Turbo/Flex任意混用。
操作：更换自己的提示词/素材 → 核对底模与作者配方 → 新任务换cache_name和输出前缀 → Queue → 检查画面、声音与参考跟随度。外部Group连接时，提示词/时长/参考以Group为准；内部时间线则编辑实际生效分段。
种子可调，不能保证固定种子绝对保身份/声音。一次仅一个GPU任务，Balanced配置，保留内存保护。任务结束清理无续作价值的分段缓存，保留模型、输入、成品和仍要返工的缓存。
作者推荐、实测配置、局限、导演台逐段介入及配套见 ComfyUI Local Workflows → H3扩展LoRA。验收样片不属于生成项目；实际项目特化画布才放Projects。
